theme_strategy: Swiss Editorial High-Contrast with Earthy Undertones
project_context: Edora v2 - AI-powered examination platform. Needs to avoid generic AI-slop, desktop-first issues, and broken microcopy from v1.

headings.rules: Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. Absolutely NO Inter font. Keep font-weights varied (Light for elegance, Black for impact).

body.rules: Clean, legible, loose line height (leading-relaxed) for student exam reading.

mono.rules: Mandatory for live stats, timer, code entry, and AI grading metrics.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure white without intention. Completely avoid indigo-on-white AI slop. Banned: Teal green, Teal blue, pure indigo, #7351B7. Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.

global.rules: Mobile-first strictly. No `.App { text-align: center; }`. Optical alignment over geometrical.

teacher_dashboard.components: Go cardless or use 1px subtle borders without massive shadows. Strip standard Vercel look from Shadcn components. Use Bento grid logic.

student_exam.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (2-3x typical). Max-width containers centered. p-8 to p-12.
student_exam.components: Distraction-free. No transparent headers. Subtle progress bars, large readable typography for questions.

motion.rules: Hover states on all interactive elements. Click/press states. Smooth staggered entrances for exam questions. NO 'transition-all'.

accessibility.rules: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Focus states must have higher contrast (e.g. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none). All interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain textures/noise on the login page background.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' (installed). Do NOT use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠💭). Keep strokes crisp (1.5px).

login_background.description: Student focused on exam, use for login/register split screen. Ensure heavy overlay (bg-black/40) if text is above it.

teacher_marketing.description: Teacher grading paper, use for teacher dashboard onboarding or empty states.

texture.description: White concrete building facade, geometric. Useful for subtle overlay or background pattern.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building Edora v2. Completely avoid the generic 'indigo-on-white' Vercel/Stripe default aesthetic.
Do NOT use the Inter font for anything.
Implement 'Cabinet Grotesk' for Headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for numbers/stats.
Fix all floating/broken microcopy from v1 by explicitly containing text in properly padded divs (p-4 or p-6) with explicit text-left or text-balance alignment.
Make the application strictly mobile-first responsive.
For the Teacher dashboard, use a dense 'Bento' or Technical grid without heavy shadows. Rely on 1px borders.
For the Student Exam view, create a distraction-free, 'Paper-like' interface. Large typography, clear visual hierarchy.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or fixed headers. Always use solid/blurred surfaces.
Every button, input, form, and interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (do not use in clinical/health/exam functional areas).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interactive states).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use standard icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use text or actual SVGs.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA or WCAG AA standards.
Implement explicit focus management for the exam palette.
Differentiate primary and secondary buttons dramatically.
Never rely on inheritance for hover states (e.g., explicitly define text color on hover).
